data.exact_reserve_text: The profit on the technical account of GBP 38.2m (2014 restated: profit GBP 62.3m) includes a run-off surplus of GBP 16.4m for prior accident years (2014: GBP 5.2m surplus). This included a surplus of GBP 5.8m for reinsurance acceptance business and a surplus of GBP 10.6m on direct business (2014: surplus of GBP 13.4m for reinsurance acceptance business and a deficit of GBP 8.2m on direct business).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a run-off surplus for prior accident years of GBP 16.4m (a release), split between reinsurance acceptance business (GBP 5.8m) and direct business (GBP 10.6m). This equates to roughly a 3.7% release on opening gross claims outstanding (~GBP 444.4m). The published claims development triangle shows favourable development for older years (notably 2011 and 2012) partially offset by adverse development on 2013.
raw_causal_phrases: run-off surplus of GBP 16.4m for prior accident years
surplus of GBP 5.8m for reinsurance acceptance business
surplus of GBP 10.6m on direct business
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development taken from Note 10 narrative 'run-off surplus of GBP 16.4m' (treated as gross). A gross claims development triangle is present and yields an alternative gross PYD estimate of approximately -13.749m (triangle excludes '2010 & prior' aggregate column). The difference may reflect movements in the aggregated '2010 & prior' column or presentation/rounding differences. 'Reinsurance acceptances' provided as a consolidated category per instructions. All monetary conversions to millions performed from GBP '000 source data.
